text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you feel it, Trainer-kun?
This taut tension, this uncooling fervor—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Many spectators in the crowd are watching our every single move."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As a stage to prove my true strength,
I'd say this is the finest there could be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. For only by piling victory upon victory
can one truly be the "Emperor" who leads all!
